name: Ascend the Hollow / Free the Hollow

description.value:
The defining choice. Choose one, permanently:

Ascend

Fuse the Hollow into your own body for good. You're not quite alive in the way you used to define it — the boundary between you and every spirit you've ever housed gets permanently thinner, and permanently stronger.

Free

Send your spirit on, somewhere gates are still supposed to open. In exchange it leaves behind a legendary, standing favor — a boon you can call on once when nothing else is left, from a spirit who no longer technically exists to grant it.
